TRANSCRIBE BURST X0-T-4 — transcriber calibration (charter § 7 X0-T), figure: F03 advanced (right figure). task_id "X0-T-4".

You are a separate instance: you have not seen any generator prompt, receipt or prior inventory, and you must not look for one.

Inputs (read-only):
- Image 1 (attached): the figure to inventory, a native-resolution crop of a painted concept sheet.
- Question set: /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/x0t/X0-T-4.questions.json — a JSON list of atomic questions over a CLOSED part list (presence question, then a dependent count question, per part).
- Strict answer schema: /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/x0t/X0-T-4.schema.json — out/inventory.json must conform to it EXACTLY (every listed part; keys `present` boolean and `count` integer ≥ 0; no other keys, no coordinates, no free text).

Part glossary (use these definitions, nothing else): hair · face · jacket = a hip-length outer garment · coat = a long (knee-length or longer) outer garment · shirt = an under-garment or visible under-layer · belt = a WAIST belt · harness_strap = a strap crossing the torso (rifle sling or chest band; NOT the waist belt) · pouch = a bag or pouch on belt or strap · tool = a hand tool carried on the person (wrench, pliers…) · trousers · boots (a pair = 2) · bracer = a forearm guard · knee_pad = a knee plate or pad · rifle = a long firearm · pauldron = a shoulder plate (either shoulder; count each) · helmet · cape · shield · staff = a hand-held staff or rod

Rules: answer every question by looking at Image 1 only. Count distinct visible instances (a pair of boots = 2; one belt with two buckles = 1). Parts that are in the list but not on this figure MUST be answered present=false, count=0 — the list is closed and deliberately includes parts that may be absent; do not assume a listed part exists. If a part is partly hidden, count what is visible and name it in concerns. Do not describe positions. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/.

WRITE: out/inventory.json (schema-exact) and out/notes.txt (≤ 12 lines: for each part you found hard to decide, one line saying why).
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "X0-T-4"): images []; calls_used 0; files = out/inventory.json + out/notes.txt with sha256; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns naming any part you could not determine (still answer it). Never PASS/FAIL.
